data_mode: web (ESPN + BBC cached); no official player ratings, best/worst are Scout's pick
headline: PSG had 66% of the ball and 698 passes to Roma's 348, but Roma created more: 2.69 xG to 1.78, 1.65 open-play xG to 0.74 and 4 big chances to 2, and left Paris with a 2-2 draw.

team_story.label: Possession
team_story.why_it_matters: PSG had two thirds of the ball
team_story.source: data/research/scrape_547e4f07d4e1.json (BBC Match Stats, Overall possession 'Paris Saint-Germain 66%Roma 34%'); data/research/scrape_bf60ae511c4b.json (ESPN match page Team Stats: Possession 66% / 34%)

team_story.label: Passes
team_story.why_it_matters: PSG made almost exactly twice as many passes, at 89.3% accuracy to 77.6%
team_story.source: data/research/scrape_547e4f07d4e1.json (BBC In-depth match stats, Total passes 'Paris Saint-Germain 698Roma 348', Pass accuracy % 89.3 / 77.6); data/research/scrape_d943eaed8076.json (ESPN team stats, Passes 698 / 348)

team_story.label: xG
team_story.why_it_matters: The side with a third of the ball made the better chances
team_story.source: data/research/scrape_547e4f07d4e1.json (BBC Match Stats, xG 'Paris Saint-Germain 1.7755Roma 2.6943', shown 1.78 / 2.69); data/research/scrape_bf60ae511c4b.json (ESPN Team Stats, Expected Goals 1.78 / 2.69). Shot-map sum 1.79 / 2.70 (rounding; analysis.py PSG_all / ROMA_all)

team_story.label: xG from open play
team_story.why_it_matters: From open play Roma made more than twice PSG's chance quality; PSG's two goals came from a corner and a penalty

team_story.why_it_matters: Roma made twice as many clear chances as PSG
team_story.source: data/research/scrape_bf60ae511c4b.json (ESPN Team Stats, Big Chances Created 2 / 4); data/research/scrape_d943eaed8076.json (ESPN team stats, Attack: Big Chances Created 2 / 4, Big Chances Missed 2 / 4)

tactical_change.trigger: double substitution at 1-1: Ousmane Dembélé for Ferran Torres, Warren Zaïre-Emery for Nuno Mendes
tactical_change.effect: Dembélé scored the 62' penalty three minutes after coming on (after Wesley's foul on Hakimi) and had 3 shots, 2 on target, 0.88 xG, PSG's highest of anyone. But PSG's open-play threat did not rise: 7 shots, 0.52 xG before 59'; 7 non-penalty shots, 0.48 xG after. Roma answered with their own bench: Malen (on 67') scored the 78' penalty.

evidence.label: Subs at 59'
evidence.after: Dembélé for Ferran Torres, Zaïre-Emery for Nuno Mendes
evidence.source: data/research/scrape_547e4f07d4e1.json (BBC line-ups: 'Ferran TorresO. Dembélé 59'', 'Nuno MendesW. Zaïre-Emery 59''); ESPN match page Substitutions 59'

evidence.label: Dembélé shots / on target / xG
evidence.source: shots_espn.json (n=17 62' pen 0.79 Goal; n=27 90'+2' 0.06 Saved; n=28 90'+5' 0.03 Off Target); analysis.py players_by_xg

evidence.label: Penalty won
evidence.after: Wesley hauled Hakimi down from behind; Dembélé's second touch after coming on
evidence.source: data/research/scrape_bf60ae511c4b.json (ESPN commentary summary: 'Wesley hauled Hakimi down from behind for a penalty. Dembele's second touch after coming on sent the keeper the wrong way to make it 2-1.'); BBC line-ups Wesley yellow card 60'

tactical_change.confidence: medium (subs, minutes and shot split are hard data; no formation change, and the effect is the penalty, not a lasting rise in chances)

best_player.name: Mario Hermoso
best_player.why: Scout's pick. A centre-back who scored the 5' opener, was the match's top shooter (5 shots, 1.20 xG, the most on either side) and also had 12 defensive interventions, 3 tackles and 6 duels won (joint-most interventions with Pacho). No player on either side matched his output at both ends.
best_player.source: data/research/scrape_bf60ae511c4b.json (ESPN Match Leaders: Total Shots 'M. Hermoso D 2 SOG, 1.20 xG 5'; Defensive Interventions 'M. Hermoso D 3 TKL, 6 DUELW 12'); shots_espn.json (n=1, 4, 9, 12, 22; analysis.py players_by_xg 5 shots, 1.20 xG)

best_psg_player.name: Vitinha
best_psg_player.why: Ran PSG's possession game (most accurate passes in the match), but gave away the 78' penalty with a handball. Mixed night; see costly_moment.
best_psg_player.source: data/research/scrape_bf60ae511c4b.json (ESPN Match Leaders: Accurate Passes 'Vitinha M 100 PASS, 0 BCC 90')

worst_player.name: Wesley
worst_player.why: Scout's pick, from very thin data. Hauled Hakimi down from behind just after the hour for the penalty that made it 2-1, and was booked at 60'. No per-player passing or duel stats are available for him, so this is about the one decisive error, not a full-game rating.
worst_player.source: data/research/scrape_bf60ae511c4b.json (ESPN commentary summary: 'Wesley hauled Hakimi down from behind for a penalty'); data/research/scrape_547e4f07d4e1.json (BBC line-ups: 'Wesley 60', Yellow Card at 60 minutes')

costly_moment.fact: Vitinha's handball (VAR decision) gave Roma the 78' penalty that Malen scored for 2-2
costly_moment.source: data/research/scrape_547e4f07d4e1.json (BBC live text: 'Penalty conceded by Vitinha (Paris Saint Germain) with a handball in the penalty area.', 'VAR Decision: Penalty Roma.', 'Goal! Paris Saint Germain 2, Roma 2. Donyell Malen (Roma) converts the penalty'); ESPN commentary summary 'Vitinha blocked a Soule shot with his hand'

surprise_stat.label: open-play xG, Roma vs PSG
surprise_stat.context: Roma had 34% of the ball and half PSG's passes (348 v 698) but more than double the open-play xG. PSG's 2 goals came from a corner and a penalty.
surprise_stat.source: data/research/scrape_547e4f07d4e1.json (BBC In-depth match stats: xG from open play 0.737 / 1.647; Total passes 698 / 348; Overall possession 66% / 34%)

caveats: No official player ratings and no per-player ESPN table ('Data is currently unavailable'); best/worst are Scout's pick from Match Leaders, the shot map and commentary. BBC fan-rating widget had not closed.
Best player is a Roma player (Hermoso): the analyst picks on numbers, not allegiance. best_psg_player is given separately for the scriptwriter.
Worst player (Wesley) rests on one decisive error (penalty conceded, single source: ESPN commentary) plus a BBC-confirmed yellow card; anger_worthy false.
xG, possession, shots (15/13), shots on target (4/4) and passes (698/348) agree between ESPN and BBC/Opta. Shot-map xG sum 1.79 / 2.70 vs 1.78 / 2.69 official (rounding): use 1.78 / 2.69.
Duels won: ESPN 39 / 41; BBC gives aerial duels only (5 / 9). Not used on the team story.
ESPN commentary claims (Malen '17th goal in 17 all-competition clashes', Dembélé 'second touch after coming on') are single-source; trend-scout should confirm before they go on screen.
'12-game winning run' is from the PA story headline on the ESPN match page; it is a trend-scout item, not used here.
Firecrawl for this step: ESPN player-stats page fell back to Firecrawl (1 credit) and added nothing new except confirming the team stats block; no searches.
ESPN lists Big Chances Missed 2 / 4, equal to Big Chances Created, even though Hermoso's 0.79 xG shot was a goal: ESPN's definitions are unclear, so 'big chances missed' is not used.
